summary: Keep WheeLog public facility evidence bounded and allowlisted, with exact aggregate report states, separate source/retrieval clocks and an explicit two-observation local shortlist. MCP context must describe the actual command mirror surface and CLI bounds. Saved reads never require migrations or writes, and immutable snapshots must reject active WAL/journal state and database changes. Source save, refresh and removal must bind to the same canonical database and validate selection/identity/link count around transactions. Saved SQL must read a bounded private snapshot copied from an fstat-verified descriptor, and writable URI-delimiter paths must fail before opening.
reason: The anonymous source envelope also includes contributor information and personal narratives; a reprint must rediscover its read-only request contract and strip those fields before cache or output. Search filters, aggregate reports and straight-line distance must never become guarantees of accessibility, individual report dates or a traversable route. Saved evidence must remain readable from a read-only cache, while an active writer must yield newest committed facts or an explicit snapshot-visibility error. Auto source successes cannot depend on opening the saved cache; failed fallback must remain explicit. An alternate hard-link WAL can lose a reported-successful observation when a canonical writer checkpoints, so writer aliases require the same safeguards as saved reads.
validated_outcome: Parser/transport/store/CLI regression tests and live search, compare, save, audit, distance, change and removal checks preserve unknowns, inapplicable questions and zero-count updates. Default --agent preserves exact question/count/requirement evidence, recheck reasons, distances and change values across collections. Read-only files keep bytes and permissions; active committed WAL is rejected, newest zero-count pairs are visible after writer close, and auto tries the source before reading fallback. Canonical target and selected-path identity are guarded; multiply linked files are refused, with Windows link counts read through file-attribute-only handles and unknown link metadata failing closed. Writer symlinks use the canonical WAL; hard links are rejected before writable open; alias additions or selected-path retargeting prevent mutations. Swapping/restoring the source pathname before first SQL query cannot substitute rows; private snapshot paths are escaped even under URI-delimiter TMPDIR, and cancellation/error/success clean up private files.
